title: Attribute-count control for the depth heuristic: depth sweep at A = 2 (colour, emotion; intensity fixed neutral), K_eff = 192
purpose: The depth series (A = 3, K_eff = 240) found L = 4 to be the shallowest depth without consistent loss. If depth tracks the number of attributes the policy reads (heuristic L = A + 1), a two-attribute policy should reach its no-loss depth at L = 3 or shallower; if the depth curve has the same shape as at A = 3, attribute count does not govern depth in this range.

fixed.pretrain: reused D-series checkpoints (d 384, 2,400 steps, per depth)
fixed.eval: A2K192 test_rule (2,000 rows, all 192 tuples covered)

comparison: D series at A = 3 (scale_grid_depth, same widths/depths/seeds/tokenizer/budget)

preregistered_predictions.P-A1 (depth tracks attributes): At A = 2 the shallowest depth within 3 pp exact of L = 8 is L = 2 (D2 - D8 > -3 pp with seeds agreeing), whereas at A = 3 it was L = 4 (D2 - D8 = -1.7 pp mean at three seeds but D2 -> D4 was an adopted +6.5 pp rise).
preregistered_predictions.P-A2 (alternative: depth independent of: The D2 -> D4 step at A = 2 is a rise of similar size to A = 3 (+6.5 pp) and adopted; then attribute count does not determine the no-loss depth in this range and L = A + 1 is not supported.
preregistered_predictions.decision_rule: Row-level McNemar per seed for D2->D4, D4->D6, D6->D8 at A = 2; Stouffer; Holm over 3 steps x 3 metrics; sign rule; plus seed-level t CIs. Interpret jointly with the A = 3 series.
